prompt.zh-CN: 下面哪句话是英语中常见的 pangram，也就是包含全部 26 个字母的句子？
prompt.en-US: Which sentence is a common English pangram, meaning it contains all 26 letters?

text.zh-CN: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
text.en-US: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

text.zh-CN: To be or not to be.
text.en-US: To be or not to be.

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 A。它常被用来测试字体，因为字母基本都能亮个相。
reveal.en-US: The answer is A. It is often used to test fonts because every letter gets a moment on stage.

fun_fact.zh-CN: pangram 来自希腊语词根，意思接近“包含所有字母”。
fun_fact.en-US: The word pangram comes from Greek roots and roughly means all letters.
